jobs.title: Chief of Staff / Strategic Finance / BizOps
jobs.description:
About Freehand

Freehand (freehand.ai http://freehand.ai) is building autonomous AI agents for enterprise spend management, replacing internal and outsourced (BPO) headcount and shared service centres with "AI Employees" across procure-to-pay and order-to-cash workflows, selling to Global 2000 CFOs.

Freehand counts Apple, Meta, J&J, Pfizer, Cardinal Health, Dunkin', and Samsara among its customers. We're now scaling the team across GTM, product, and operations.



The Role

We're hiring two Founder's Office roles to take on the highest-leverage strategic projects across the company: fundraising, board and investor comms, org design, key customer expansions, revenue operations, cost optimization, and special initiatives that don't yet have an owner. You'll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, with end-to-end ownership of workstreams that shape how Freehand scales. This is a front-row seat to building a category-defining enterprise AI company in San Francisco.



How we think about the business

Freehand, like any business, runs on five pipelines: capital, talent, sales, implementations, and product. Each has its own throughput, conversion, and cycle time, and each both constrains and feeds the others, and the overall business. The Chief of Staff / Strategic Finance role is to make those interactions legible, financially, operationally, and visually, and to actively de-bottleneck them.



What you'll do

 - Build the top-down financial model of the business as the intersecting output of the five pipelines, and decompose it into functional models for sales, implementations, product, talent, and capital

 - Identify the dynamic binding constraint in each pipeline and at the company level; quantify the cost of each bottleneck and the ROI of unblocking it

 - Stand up dashboards for each pipeline and a consolidated business view, leading indicators, throughput, conversion, cycle time, unit economics

 - Partner with each function head to set weekly, monthly and quarterly goals tied to the model, and drive a prioritized list of debottlenecking initiatives across the company

 - Run weekly functional reviews and fortnightly business reviews alongside the CEO

 - Own strategic initiatives across customer expansion, pricing, org design, and cost optimization, and other high-leverage problems that don't yet have an owner

 - Run board meetings end-to-end: materials, narrative, follow-ups, investor materials, modeling, process management
   
   

Ideal background

 - CS undergrad from top tier college in India (IIT/NIT) or the US (Ivy League school); MBA from HBS, Wharton, or Stanford

 - At least 2-4 years in investment banking or private equity

 - At least 2-4 years in an operating role (BizOps / Strategic Finance) at a consumer tech or B2B software company

 - Founder or very early-stage startup experience is a strong plus

 - Proven track record of hands on financial modelling across GTM, product, tech and ops; comfortable moving between board-level strategy, management decision making and hands-on functional execution
   
   

Working at Freehand

We proudly offer the following Benefits to all our full-time employees:

 - Take what you need Vacation Policy

 - Monthly home-internet costs

 - Full health coverage (with multiple gold-standard carriers across medical, dental & vision)

 - Life Insurance and Disability benefits

 - HSA/FSA Access

 - 401(k) with a 4% Employer Match
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Freehand hires on merit — your thinking, your track record, your potential — without regard to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you meet most of the criteria above but not all of it, apply anyway. We care more about your willingness to learn & take initiative than whether your resume maps perfectly to every line.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT FREEHAND

Most AI companies are building tools. We're building the worker.

Freehand is the AI Team that runs Accounts Payable and spend operations for the world's largest enterprises, negotiating rates, enforcing contracts, managing suppliers, processing payments, and reconciling data across enterprise systems. It's work that's always required armies of analysts, BPOs, and offshore teams to keep supply chains running.

The tech industry has spent years competing for a $16B software market. We're going after the $348B enterprises spend on labor instead, building the AI Team that doesn't promise incremental efficiency gains, but owns the outcome, with the ROI to prove it. Meta, Unilever, J&J, Pfizer, and Cardinal Health are already running parts of their operations on Freehand, and we're just getting started.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Freehand is seeking a Head of Growth Marketing to turn our market opportunity into qualified pipeline. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you'll own the growth strategy and pipeline target across net-new and expansion, deciding where to invest, building the programs to support those bets, and scaling what works.

This is a hands-on builder role and our first dedicated growth marketing hire. You'll shape the function from the ground up, working closely with Marketing, Outbound Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and other teams to create a repeatable growth motion.

Pipeline & Growth Strategy: Own the marketing pipeline target and plan. Define our audience and account strategy, channel mix, campaign roadmap, and investment priorities.

Integrated Campaigns: Build and run campaigns across ABM, digital, content, events, partners, webinars, email, and outbound plays. Turn market opportunities into focused programs with clear audiences, offers, and outcomes.

Account-Based Growth: Partner with Outbound Sales on account selection, buying groups, campaign plays, follow-up, and conversion.

Experimentation & New Channels: Test new ways to create pipeline, measure results, and scale the programs and channels that work.

Funnel & Measurement: Own the growth dashboard and operating cadence. Identify what is working, where conversion is breaking, and what to do next. Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales to improve pipeline quality and conversion.

Expansion Growth: Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to create programs that expand customers into additional spend categories and workflows.

Cross-Functional GTM: Turn company priorities into coordinated go-to-market motions with Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Outbound Sales, Events, Partnerships, and Customer Success.

Build the Function: Establish the operating model, processes, and resources needed to scale growth marketing over time.




YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

 - You own the number. You're accountable for qualified pipeline, not just leads, clicks, or campaign activity.

 - You're a builder and an operator. You can set the strategy and execute the work yourself.

 - You think in audiences and accounts. You know how to identify the right accounts, reach the right buying groups, and create reasons for them to engage.

 - You build campaigns that sell. You've turned a market opportunity or buyer problem into an integrated campaign that produced measurable pipeline.

 - You're analytical. You understand funnel performance, channel economics, CAC, and pipeline math, and use data to decide what to do next.

 - You experiment. You form hypotheses, launch quickly, learn, and iterate.

 - You work tightly with Outbound Sales. You know how to build shared account strategies, plays, and follow-up.

 - You understand enterprise buying. You're comfortable marketing to CFOs and senior executives while engaging the functional leaders who experience the problem every day.

 - You enjoy creating something from scratch. You're energized by making smart bets, learning quickly, and building a function that can scale.

 - You can do more with less. You've operated effectively without a large budget or team.




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - 8+ years in growth marketing, demand generation, or revenue marketing for a B2B enterprise technology company.

 - Proven ownership of pipeline targets and a track record of generating qualified pipeline and revenue.

 - Experience building integrated, multi-channel campaigns and ABM programs.

 - Strong command of funnel analytics, experimentation, and marketing performance measurement.

 - Experience partnering closely with enterprise Sales and Revenue Operations teams on targeting, pipeline creation, and conversion.

 - Hands-on experience across digital channels, including paid, email, website conversion, SEO/SEM, and emerging growth channels.

 - Excellent written, analytical, and executive communication skills.

 - Bachelor's degree required.




AN IDEAL CANDIDATE ALSO HAS:

 - Experience building a growth function or motion from the ground up.

 - Experience marketing to large enterprise accounts with complex buying groups and long sales cycles.

 - Experience driving both net-new acquisition and customer expansion.

 - Experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, supply chain, procurement, or AI.

 - Experience using AI and automation to make growth marketing more efficient.

 - A track record of finding and scaling new channels rather than relying on an inherited demand generation playbook.

 - Experience determining when to use internal execution, contractors, agencies, technology, or future hires to scale growth efficiently.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Freehand

Most AI companies are building tools. We're building the worker.

Freehand's AI agents replace the human decision-making and coordination layer that sits above enterprise software — handling the analysis, negotiation, prioritization, and execution that previously required armies of logisticians / supply chain professionals.

Our customers include Apple, Meta, GE, Pfizer, J&J, Schlumberger, Cardinal Health, and Unilever. They chose us because we have a fundamentally different answer to what enterprise software looks like when AI can do the job.

If you want to work on something that matters, with people who will push you to be sharper than you thought you could be, this is the place.

The Role & The Team
This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly into leadership, with no team to manage. We want someone who's genuinely hands-on: building their own decks, running their own demos, writing their own partner collateral, and closing their own relationships. There's no support infrastructure to lean on yet; you're building it.

We're open on exactly how this role is structured, depending on who we find:

 - One person, both channels : If you bring real System Integrator (SI) and Private Equity/ISV partnership experience, we'll hire you into a single role covering both channels at a premium.

 - Two people, one channel each: If your background is strong in only one of these areas, we're equally happy to hire two specialists.

 - SI Partnerships: Could be a partner sales or partner marketing background — building and running relationships with systems integrators.

 - PE Channel Partnerships: must have experience selling to industrial- or consumer-focused private equity firms, who in turn open doors to their portfolio companies.

 - Alternative path: if the partnerships hires aren't a slam dunk, we're also open to a very hungry ABM marketer or product marketer with a track record of building strong external relationships and a genuine hustle to move into partnerships. Whichever shape this takes, you'll be one of the earliest strategic hires in this function, with outsized influence over how Freehand's partner ecosystem gets built from scratch.
   
   
   What You'll Do

 - Partner pipeline generation — Identify, prioritize, and build relationships with SIs, PE firms, and/or ISV/product partners relevant to accounts payable, procurement, supply chain, and finance ops

 - Deal collaboration — Work hand-in-hand with these partners to source, co-sell, and close enterprise deals, acting as the connective tissue between their relationships and Freehand's sales motion

 - Collateral and enablement, self-built — Create your own partner decks, one-pagers, demo scripts, and pitch materials; there's no dedicated support team, so you own the full production

 - Demos and pitches — Run partner- and prospect-facing demos yourself, translating Freehand's agentic AI capabilities into value propositions relevant to each partner type

 - PE portfolio company motion — For the PE channel, build the specific muscle of pitching PE firms on Freehand as a value-creation lever across their industrial/consumer portfolio, then working through to individual portco engagements

 - SI relationship building — For the SI channel, build joint go-to-market motions, referral pipelines, and co-delivery relationships with systems integrators serving supply chain and finance transformation

 - Feedback loop to product/GTM — Bring market and partner intelligence back to product and marketing to sharpen positioning and roadmap prioritization
   
   Who You Are

 -  Startup or scale-up sales/partnerships experience — you've built something like this before, not just maintained an existing program

 -  High-pedigree intellect — top-tier engineering or MBA background

 - An athlete or high performer in whatever form that's taken in your life — competitive, driven, and used to winning

 -  A true individual contributor at heart: scrappy, comfortable doing the work yourself (decks, demos, outreach) rather than delegating

 -  Some exposure to accounts payable, supply chain, finance, or logistics — you don't need to be a domain expert, but you should be conversant enough to build credibility fast

 -  If pursuing the premium single-role path: proven SI and PE/ISV partnership experience

 -  If pursuing a single-channel path: deep, specific experience in either SI partnerships or PE-channel selling (with the PE track specifically requiring experience selling to industrial/consumer-focused PE firms to reach their portfolio companies)

 -  If coming from marketing: a demonstrated hustle and relationship-building track record as an ABM or product marketer, with real hunger to move into a partnerships-facing role

 -  Comfortable with ambiguity and building process from scratch at an early-stage, fast-moving startup


Working at Freehand

Series B, ~100 people across the US and India. Big enough to have infrastructure, small enough that your work is visible. We run on five core operating principles; these are not values-on-a-wall, this is the exact philosophy we built our AI agents on :

 - Context Before Confidence. We get in, ask (a ton of) questions, connect the dots ourselves and move fast. No passengers, no hand-holding. The amount of confidence you'll have in Week 1 is directly proportional to the context strive to gain.

 - Decisions, not Recommendations. Freehand folks decide, they don't present options. You'll have real autonomy, and real accountability to match.

 - High Agency, High Trust. We won't manage you closely or ask you to escalate every call. Act, share your reasoning, and course-correct when needed. That's the contract.

 - Accountability is the Product. When something goes wrong — and it will — we name it, learn from it, and move on. No politics, no cover. Just fix it.

 - The Work That Remains is the Work That Matters. We actively cut low-value work. What lands on your plate is there because it matters — and can only be done by you.

It's a small world. Freehand employees Work Anywhere across the globe (we're remote & travel-first). We also cover your monthly home-internet costs. Every quarter, we arrange for a fully-paid trip to one of our Office Hubs to meet & interact with cross-functional teams.

In addition, we proudly offer the following Benefits to all our full-time employees:

 - Take what you need Vacation Policy

 - Monthly home-internet costs

 - Full health coverage (with multiple gold-standard carriers across medical, dental & vision)

 - Life Insurance and Disability benefits

 - HSA/FSA Access

 - 401(k) with a 4% Employer Match

 - Fully-paid Parental Leave
   

Equal Opportunity

Freehand hires on merit — your thinking, your track record, your potential — without regard to race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic. If you meet most of the criteria above but not all of it, apply anyway. We care more about your willingness to learn & take initiative than whether your resume maps perfectly to every line
